# @fyit/crouton-layout

> Deterministic layout engine — editor, renderer, default-layout pass, placeable blocks, and layout_configs storage

## Components

- `CroutonLayout`: The editable panes surface
- `CroutonLayoutBreakpointAuthor`: Breakpoints level of the Crouton Builder: author responsiveness by demonstration
- `CroutonLayoutCollection`: Data-bound list block for a layout
- `CroutonLayoutForm`: Data-bound form block: the detail half of a master/detail layout
- `CroutonLayoutRenderer`: Renders a layout data tree into resizable, nestable panes
- `CroutonLayoutSpikeStats`: Throwaway stats block from the layout spike (#713); goes when the spike does.
- `CroutonLayoutStoreScope`: Owns the layout store copies that the layouts rendered inside it read; wrap a page's layouts in it.

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)
